description: Monster stat system. Monsters use the same primary stats (STR/INT/DEX/STA) and derived stat formulas as players. Monster stats scale with dungeon difficulty level.

difficulty_scaling.description: Monster base stats are designed for difficulty 1. For higher difficulties, multiply all primary stats.

undead.description: Reanimated dead. Vulnerable to holy, resistant to dark and poison.

beast.description: Natural creatures. Balanced stats, sometimes fast, sometimes tough.

demon.description: Infernal creatures. Resistant to fire and dark, vulnerable to holy.

elemental.description: Beings of pure elemental energy. Strongly resist their own element, weak to the opposite.

humanoid.description: Intelligent humanoid enemies. Balanced, can use tactics and equipment.

bruiser.description: High HP/STR, low DEX. Hits hard, takes hits.

skirmisher.description: High DEX, moderate STR. Fast and evasive.

caster.description: High INT, low STA. Dangerous magic but fragile.

tank.description: Very high STA, moderate STR. Absorbs damage.

support.description: High INT, moderate STA. Heals and buffs allies.

swarm.description: Low individual stats, appears in groups.
